evals.prompt: Check skill conflicts with kerpo. Session skills: kerpo-tdd, kerpo-git-status, vercel-react-best-practices (React/Next.js performance), find-skills (discover installable skills), create-rule (Cursor rules). No other TDD or git-status skills.
